compat.cache.expired: The refreshed data has expired: its restrictions still apply, but nothing it checks or verifies is trusted until it is refreshed again.
compat.cache.from_newer_product: The refreshed data needs a newer version of Codex Auto Resume, so the data bundled with this version applies.
compat.cache.from_the_future: The refreshed data is dated after this computer's clock: its restrictions apply, but nothing it checks or verifies is trusted until the clock is right.
compat.cache.rejected: The refreshed data on this computer could not be used, so the data bundled with this version applies.
compat.cache.superseded: The refreshed data is older than the data bundled with this version, which applies instead.

compat.meaning.COMPATIBLE: Compatible: the checks on this computer pass, but the maintainer has neither checked nor verified this exact Codex version.
compat.meaning.FAILED_HERE: Failed here: this exact Codex version is checked or verified, but a check on this computer failed, so the cause is most likely this computer rather than the Codex version.
compat.meaning.INCOMPATIBLE: Incompatible: a check on this computer failed on a Codex version nobody has checked, or the compatibility data says it does not work with this Codex version.
compat.meaning.UNKNOWN: Unknown: it could not be established, because a check could not run on this computer.
compat.meaning.VERIFIED: Verified: a real recovery on this exact Codex version has confirmed it.
compat.meaning.CHECKED: Checked: the maintainer's checks pass on this exact Codex version, but no real recovery on it has confirmed this yet.
compat.refused.future: it is dated after this computer's clock
compat.refused.invalid: it is not valid compatibility data
compat.refused.newer: it needs a newer version of Codex Auto Resume
compat.refused.not_saved: it could not be saved on this computer
compat.refused.rollback: it is older than the data already in force
compat.status.absent: No check yet: the watcher checks when it runs.
compat.status.engine_changed: Codex has changed since the last check. Stop the watcher and start it again to check the new version.
compat.status.invalid: The last check could not be read, so nothing in it is relied on.
compat.status.stale: The last check is too old to rely on. The watcher checks again while it runs.
compat.title: Codex compatibility
confirm.cancel: Stop recovering "{name}"? A continuation already running in Codex is not stopped.
confirm.cancel_all: Stop every pending recovery? Anything already handed to Codex is withdrawn only if it is still queued.
confirm.clear: Hide finished recoveries from the history? Nothing is deleted, and recoveries that may still change stay visible.
confirm.repair: Run setup again to repair the Windows registrations, and start the watcher if it is stopped? Settings, pending recoveries, a pause and the sign-in choice are all kept.
confirm.reset: Give "{name}" its attempts back? It waits and is checked again; nothing is sent now.
confirm.stop_watcher: Stop the watcher? It finishes the check it is in and then stops. Nothing waiting is lost, and nothing is recovered until it runs again.
confirm.thread_off: Turn automatic recovery off for "{name}"? Its waiting recoveries are cancelled.
confirm.thread_on: Turn automatic recovery back on for "{name}"? Nothing is sent now; every check still applies.
confirm.update: Version {latest} has been published. Download and install it? The archive is checked against its published checksum before anything runs, and your settings, your pause, everything waiting and the sign-in choice are all kept.

help.continuation_language: The language of the message sent to Codex. Unless it follows the interface, changing the interface language leaves it as it is.
help.interface_language: Used by the Dashboard, the notification-area popup, notifications and the panel in Codex.
help.limits: Sets how hard recovery tries before it stops and leaves the task to you.
help.notification_card: Notifications appear as a card beside the notification area and are also kept in Windows' notification center. When this is off - or while Do not disturb is on, an app is full screen, a screen reader is running, or the session is locked or remote - Windows shows its own notification instead.
help.recovery: Only kinds of failure the product can recognize are ever recovered. Turning one off stops it; turning one on cannot make an unknown failure recoverable.
help.reduce_motion: Stops every animation - the status light's breathing, controls that glide, a notification card sliding in - in the Dashboard, the notification-area popup and icon, the notification card, the taskbar button and the panel in Codex, in every design. Soft, without motion has none to stop. Windows' own Animation effects setting is always honored as well.
help.start_with_codex: Codex starts this plugin whenever it opens, and the watcher starts with it if it is not already running. This is separate from starting at sign-in: either or both can be on. It changes nothing about what is recovered.
help.style.custom: Your own words, sent exactly as you type them.
help.style.detailed: Also asks Codex to check the work so far and continue without repeating what is done.
help.style.minimal: Only asks Codex to retry, without saying why.
help.style.standard: Says why the task stopped, then asks Codex to retry. Recommended.
help.theme: Light or dark for the Dashboard, the notification-area popup and the notification card, and for the panel in Codex while Theme in Codex is Same as Theme. Use system setting follows Windows for the first three and Codex's own theme for the panel.
help.panel_theme: Light or dark for the panel in Codex alone. Same as Theme uses the choice above; Codex's theme follows Codex whatever the Theme is.
help.design: How the Dashboard, the notification-area popup, the notification card and the panel in Codex are drawn; light or dark is still the Theme's. Soft is raised and moves; Soft, without motion looks the same and holds still; Classic (v0.6.2) is flat, with that version's accent bars; Plain is flat and grey. High Contrast replaces every design, and Reduce motion stops the motion in each.
history.reset_limit: Its attempts were already given back as many times as allowed; continue this task in Codex yourself.
